training_expansion: Late-2024 Mexico, Brazil, Las Vegas, Qatar and Abu Dhabi; 2023 Las Vegas for prior circuit support. No held-out circuit data may enter fitting.
validation_policy: Rolling leave-one-validation-race-out evaluation of candidate calibration/selection; final calibration on validation only. No holdout outcomes until selection artifact is written.

eligibility_policy.unverified_routine_candidates: Retain explicitly screened-unverified; require separate confirmed-only sensitivity.
eligibility_policy.unknown_cause: Never infer repair or penalty from duration alone.

selection_policy.primary: race-weighted CRPS with MAE and probabilistic eligibility constraints
selection_policy.constraints: Finite distributions; nonzero modeled slow-stop risk when validation contains slow stops; report coverage and widths. Use simple probabilistic fallback if complexity adds no validation benefit.

holdout_policy: Evaluate familiar/unseen separately once; no retuning to either new test population.
